# Paths that make a pull request HIGH RISK. High-risk PRs merge only after the owner
# comments `/approve-risk <head sha>` (risk-gate). Gitignore-like globs: `**` spans
# directories, `*` stays within one segment, a pattern without `/` matches at any depth.
# Keep this list short and meaningful: everything here costs the owner attention.
